en.title: Bangladesh's fuel bill just jumped 63%. Here's why.
en.caption: Oil is pricey, the taka needs a bodyguard, and cash deals are dodging tax. Your sixty-second catch-up. Not investment advice.

segments.label: ENERGY
segments.narration: Imagine your bazar bill jumping by more than half in one go. That just happened to Bangladesh's fuel bill. Up approximately 63% in a quarter, with crude oil past $110 a barrel.

segments.label: TRADE
segments.narration: Here's the twist. We pay for that oil in dollars. It's like your salary staying the same while every bill doubles. Spend more dollars abroad, and the trade deficit grows, and prices at home creep up.

segments.label: RESERVE
segments.narration: So Bangladesh Bank stepped in like an older sibling in a fight. It sold $20 million from its reserves to banks, to keep the taka steady. Translation? Your groceries don't suddenly get pricier.

segments.label: TAX
segments.narration: Meanwhile, cash deals are the friend who never pays back. A central bank study says unrecorded cash costs the government Tk 933 billion in tax a year. Guess who borrows to fill the gap? The government.

segments.label: TODAY'S LESSON
segments.narration: Today's term: open market operations. Fancy name, simple idea. The central bank buys or sells dollars or bonds in the market, like a shopkeeper adjusting stock, to steer the exchange rate and the money in banks.

banglish.title: Fuel er bill 63% barlo! Keno?
banglish.caption: Oil er dam akashe, taka ke bodyguard dite holo, ar cash deal tax faki dicche. Eta investment advice na.

segments.label: ENERGY
segments.narration: Bhabun, ammu-r bazar er list hothat ordhek er beshi bere gelo. Thik eitai hoyeche Bangladesh er fuel bill er sathe. Ek quarter e prai 63% beshi, karon oil er dam $110 per barrel cross koreche.
segments.speech: ভাবুন, আম্মুর বাজারের list হঠাৎ অর্ধেকের বেশি বেড়ে গেল। ঠিক এইটাই হয়েছে Bangladesh এর fuel bill এর সাথে। এক quarter এ প্রায় 63% বেশি, কারণ oil এর দাম $110 per barrel cross করেছে।

segments.label: TRADE
segments.narration: Ekhon moja ta holo, ei oil kinte hoy dollar diye. Mash shesh e salary same, kintu shob bill double, emon obostha. Dollar beshi bairer dike gele trade deficit baray, ar desher bhitore jinish er dam o bare.
segments.speech: এখন মজাটা হলো, এই oil কিনতে হয় dollar দিয়ে। মাস শেষে salary same, কিন্তু সব bill double, এমন অবস্থা। Dollar বেশি বাইরের দিকে গেলে trade deficit বাড়ে, আর দেশের ভিতরে জিনিসের দামও বাড়ে।

segments.label: RESERVE
segments.narration: Tai Bangladesh Bank boro bhai er moto maath e namlo. Reserve theke $20 million banks er kache bikri korlo, jate taka stable thake. Mane? Apnar bazar er dam hothat lafay na.
segments.speech: তাই Bangladesh Bank বড় ভাইয়ের মতো মাঠে নামলো। Reserve থেকে $20 million banks এর কাছে বিক্রি করলো, যাতে taka stable থাকে। মানে? আপনার বাজারের দাম হঠাৎ লাফায় না।

segments.label: TAX
segments.narration: Ar cash deal holo oi bondhu je dhar niye ar ferot dey na. Central bank er ekta study bolche, record chara cash er karone sarkar bochore Tk 933 billion tax hariye fele. Gap puron korte abar loan.
segments.speech: আর cash deal হলো ওই বন্ধু যে ধার নিয়ে আর ফেরত দেয় না। Central bank এর একটা study বলছে, record ছাড়া cash এর কারণে সরকার বছরে Tk 933 billion tax হারিয়ে ফেলে। Gap পূরণ করতে আবার loan।

segments.label: AJKER LESSON
segments.narration: Ajker term open market operations. Naam ta bhari, idea ta simple. Dokandar jemon stock baray-komay, central bank temni market e dollar ba bond kene-beche, exchange rate ar bank er taka control korte.
segments.speech: আজকের term open market operations। নামটা ভারী, idea টা simple। দোকানদার যেমন stock বাড়ায়-কমায়, central bank তেমনি market এ dollar বা bond কেনে-বেচে, exchange rate আর bank এর টাকা control করতে।
